page.layout: One column of running text, centred on the page. Below it: a small printer's ornament, the closing line "Finis Libri primi Nuclei Physici." in italic, and a woodcut emblem. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature bottom left, catchword bottom right. Ghosted text in the right margin is show-through and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: stant usum, & insunt medicamentis,un-guentis, aromatis, &c. hoc genus odo-rum dicitur proprium esse hominis.
Varietatem quoque odoribus affer-re solent proprietates naturarum singu-lares, quibus odorantes sunt praediti, ut quod mihi suave, alii non est suave.
Odorem Stercoris nemo bene fert, at in hoc Scarabei & Sues delitias suas quaerunt. Satis de qualitatibus corporum.

page.notes: Printer's ornament between the text and the closing line (a row of small scroll and fleuron marks, "•§):(§•", with a pendant fleuron below) is decoration, not text, and is left out. The woodcut emblem at the foot (a central face with scrolls, banner and two animal heads) is an illustration; its banner has letters that I cannot read reliably, so I have not transcribed them. Show-through from the reverse page appears in the right margin and is excluded. The swash "N" of "Nuclei" is a decorative capital and is transcribed as N.
